dimensions.assessment: Directly affects air traffic control towers operating under contract without existing tools, their operators, and air traffic controllers.
dimensions.evidence: air traffic control towers of the Federal Aviation Administration that are operating under contract... and not equipped with Standard Terminal Automation Replacement Systems

dimensions.assessment: Improves situational awareness equipment and provides mandatory training and potential retroactive reimbursements.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration shall acquire and install certified airborne position reference tools at air traffic control towers

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes expenditures for acquisitions, installations, annual operating expenses, maintenance, and reimbursements or retroactive grants.
dimensions.evidence: The acquisition, installation, and annual operating expenses of certified Airborne Position Reference Tools

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing titles of the U.S. Code relating to contract towers, equipment installation, funding, and training programs.

dimensions.assessment: Requires installation within one year of enactment, with ongoing annual operating expenses and permanent statutory amendments.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates the acquisition, installation, and maintenance of specific air traffic situational awareness tools and systems at certain contract-operated airport towers within one year.
